summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency resolves attacker-mutable code at install time
details: package.json declares a runtime dependency `libsignal` with the source `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` — a bare GitHub reference to a personal user repository with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, npm resolves this to whatever the current HEAD of that repository returns, including any lifecycle scripts (`preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`/`prepare`) present in the fetched tree. The content is not pinned, not integrity-checked, and not sourced from the npm registry, so any future change to that third-party repo is executed on every installer's machine without any further action by the package maintainer. The declared package name `raiden-baileys` and the WhatsApp-library framing of the surrounding code do not alter the resolution path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
